item.title: Pakistan Targets 3,000 EV Charging Stations by 2030
item.description: Pakistan unveiled a plan to install 3,000 EV charging stations by 2030, with 240 planned for the current fiscal year.

item.title: Rawalpindi–Islamabad Metro Set for Fixes: New Joint Committee Formed
item.description: The Federal & Punjab governments have formed a joint committee to urgently overhaul the Rawalpindi-Islamabad Metro Bus Service.
